the QCDSRs provide a more precise determination of the condensate parameters and that they can be used to constrain various models of hadron structure and interactions.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have a new method to determine the condensates and a new sum rule for the magnetic moments.
the QCDSRs for μ -s are more restrictive in comparison with the ones for masses and decay constants.
the experimental magnetic moments are more consistent with the quark model and QCD than a model based on the Wilson loop and chiral quark models.

the QCDSRs are more powerful than the CGSR in constraining models.
